summary: Immutable worker-job revisions bind every admitted lane end to end. Implementation v27 and break-fix v24 require one typed owner/case/control acceptance oracle in the job digest, with closed source and authority joins and retained readiness evidence. Earlier pins remain oracle-free. Local acceptance holds the step without delivery; whole-work delivery keeps complete parent admission and integration evidence. Earlier unresolved obligations require unchanged base content and byte-identical old controls; added coverage can strengthen them, but control deletion or recipe re-pinning cannot discharge debt or reset retries.
title: Worker jobs bind dispatch and separate local acceptance from delivery
